paraphrase: For the selected possible W, the source constructs C with all-and-only commitments to the particular contingent things that exist or have existed in W, including the possible empty roster. These are fixed particular bearers, not A3’s nonrigid first occurrence. W includes C, in the source sense that C would obtain were W actual; the source infers C possible. This does not independently admit a typed fact token, reduce historical occurrence to current existence, or determine an entire future history.
